name: professor-orb-marketplace
description: Mr. Beasley's personal Claude Code plugins for tabletop campaign management.

plugins.name: professor-orb
plugins.description: Post-session workflow suite for D&D DMs: debrief, prep, content, lore updates, campaign chronology, and homebrew design. Applies its own knowledge base structure and offers to keep your campaign in version control.

plugins.name: foundryvtt
plugins.description: Foundry VTT toolkit. live-test tries a module, macro or automation change in a signed-in world through the browser, on throwaway actors, logging problems to a report instead of fixing mid-wave.

plugins.name: beas-reflect
plugins.description: Captures your corrections and turns them into CLAUDE.md notes written as the action to take, naming the thing each note is about. Based on claude-reflect by Bayram Annakov.
